html:
SMTO-MON-0007 — SMTO needs more detail to set up this monitor

GUID: 9f813a34-09ea-4ce7-8d8a-1d01265b695d
Slug: monitor-command-unclear
Domain: MON · Subsystem: mon

What happened

  • SMTO couldn't work out which command the monitor should run from your description, so it didn't create the monitor. It lists the details it still needs.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Read the missing details listed with this error and add each one to your request. SMTO names exactly what it couldn't work out from your description.
  2. Put the exact command in backticks, for example df -h, and say which Gateway it should run on. A command in backticks is used as written, so SMTO doesn't have to guess it.
  3. Add how often to check and for how long, such as every 30 seconds for 10 minutes. With the timing stated, SMTO can build the whole monitor in one step.

What success looks like

  • The monitor is created and shows a queued or running status.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them, with your request, to the person who manages SMTO. Don't resend the same description unchanged; it will get the same result.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Prompt-only monitor creation (MonitorRoutes.create_agent_monitor) got no first draft with a command and empty missing_details, so it returned HTTP 422 listing the missing fields.

What this means

  • Prompt-based creation fails to obtain a first draft containing a command with no missing_details and returns the missing fields instead of creating the monitor. Monitor validation does not execute the observation command. Existing monitor state and stored observations remain authoritative; missing planning support or exhausted judgment budget does not prove observation collection failed.

Why this can happen

  • Prompt-based creation fails to obtain a first draft containing a command with no missing_details and returns the missing fields instead of creating the monitor.

How to diagnose it

  • Read the returned missing_details and proposed command rather than guessing the observation target.

How to fix it

  • Supply command (and gateway_id) explicitly in the create payload, or a prompt containing a backticked command or a recognized probe (GPU, free memory, disk), and resolve the returned missing_details. See command_from_prompt in src/agent_runtime/monitors/drafting.py.
  • Provide the exact target and command or clarify the missing monitor details shown by the draft.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • An explicit complete command and required target details pass creation validation.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • Monitor validation does not execute the observation command. Existing monitor state and stored observations remain authoritative; missing planning support or exhausted judgment budget does not prove observation collection failed.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
